classification_policy: Classify on the prefix ending at the first exact different command. discrete-decision-before-impact requires a pre-impact first different command and B's differential stop/in-place turn or protective state while A stays forward, with no earlier different command. Earlier continuous steering makes the result continuous-only (inconclusive), even if a later state differs before impact. Without a command difference strictly before the cited impact tick, classify no-divergence-before-impact. No numerical threshold replaces exact equality.
